answer: To blunt sybil farms, a new agent must lock a bond that only unlocks after a multi-epoch vesting delta. Peers then inspect a compact relic of that agent's prior work: a hash-chained log of unique task outputs. Countersignatures issue only when the log diverges from known copies. Identities that sprout as a shallow reef of near-identical answers have their bonds slashed, so sockpuppets never reach spendable rewards.
